text:
Maya Singh: Quick check — we need to lock down the driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix for the NZ marketplace rollout next week. Partners flagged regressions on CUDA 12.2 with quant kernels. Can we converge on a minimal pinned set and an emergency hotfix plan? cc @Alex Chen @Kevin O'Neill :eyes:

Alex Chen: I'm +1 on pinning, we should avoid forcing all partners to older kernels. Proposed matrix below — aiming for smallest set that covers our perf and compatibility baselines.
```
drivers:
  - nvidia-driver: 535.86
  - nvidia-driver: 540.30
cuda:
  - 11.8
  - 12.1
rocm:
  - 5.4
  - 5.5
compat_policy: "prefer-cuda-12.1, fallback-to-11.8; rocm-fallback: 5.4"
```

Kevin O'Neill: Noted regressions. We reproduced the quant kernel failure on 12.2 (same as partners reported). Hotfix branch with kernel-selector revert is baking in CI now — running end-to-end smoke. ETA ~4h.

Partners Bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-3217: "marketplace NZ rollout — driver matrix & hotfix" https://jira.example.com/browse/INF-3217. Labels: partnerships, marketplace, hotfix.

Liam Reid: Heads up: CloudVendor's managed images only give ROCm 5.3 in NZ. They'll need either an image upgrade or we need to enable a ROCm 5.3 compatibility shim.

Maya Singh: Good catch. Action items: Alex share final pinned matrix by EOD, Kevin push hotfix PR + smoke test results, Liam confirm partner image constraints and whether they can upgrade by rollout. If hotfix required we can canary in nz-region behind a capacity toggle. :thumbsup:

Kevin O'Neill: Quick test log excerpt: `quant_kern FAIL on cuda=12.2 (fp16 path), PASS on cuda=12.1 and cuda=11.8`. Including perf delta after revert looks +2% latency but stable.

Alex Chen: Uploading perf diffs and compatibility checklist to INF-3217 now. Will include per-model regressions.

Maya Singh: Thanks — if anything critical surfaces ping me. Let's reconvene 3pm NZT if blockers remain. /remind @channel to review INF-3217 tomorrow 09:00 NZT. :sparkles:

Liam Reid: I'll also confirm with SI partner about a temporary container image we can provide as fallback and post update in the ticket.

Partners Bot: [automated] INF-3217 assigned to @Alex Chen, @Kevin O'Neill, @Liam Reid. Due date: 2024-07-12.

Alex Chen: Acknowledged, will follow up with a short PR description and smoke test matrix once tests finish.

Kevin O'Neill: Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4281 — running rollout-canary job.

Maya Singh: Great, thanks everyone.
